what: The Net Worth Calculator adds up what you own and subtracts what you owe. It shows your net worth, your total assets and liabilities, your debt-to-asset ratio and a breakdown of where your money is.
Your list and any snapshots you save stay in this browser only, so next time you open the page they are still there. Saving a snapshot every month or so builds a chart of your progress.
uses: Get one number that sums up your finances.
Save monthly snapshots and watch the trend.
Check your debt-to-asset ratio and largest debts.
Check your position before buying a home or changing jobs.
Copy the totals or download a CSV for your records.
tutorial: Choose it in "Currency" or pick "Other" to type a symbol.
Under "What you own", type the value of cash, investments, retirement savings, property and vehicles. Rename rows or click "+ Add asset" for more.
Under "What you owe", type balances for your mortgage, loans and cards. Click "+ Add debt" for more.
See "Your net worth", the totals and the debt-to-asset ratio. The bars show each item's share.
Pick a date and click "Save snapshot". Saving again on the same date updates it.
The chart and table show each snapshot and the change since the last one. Use × to delete one.
features: Up to 60 assets and 60 debts with your own names.
Net worth, totals and debt ratio update as you type.
See which assets and debts are biggest.
Your list and snapshots are kept in your browser, never uploaded.
A line chart of net worth and debts across your snapshots.
Download your list and history to keep or open in a spreadsheet.

example.title: Worked example
example.text: Cash 12,000, investments 30,500, and a home worth 250,000 give assets of 292,500. A mortgage of 180,000 and a credit card balance of 2,500 give debts of 182,500. Net worth is 292,500 − 182,500 = 110,000 and the debt-to-asset ratio is 62.4%.

tips: Use realistic sale values, not purchase prices, for property and cars.
Update on the same day each month so snapshots compare fairly.
Do not count the same thing twice, such as a house and its deposit.
Download a CSV now and then as a backup if you clear your browser data.
problems: It is stored in this browser only. A different browser, device, private window or cleared site data will not have it.
